_comment: Reference config for every Phase 2 diarization benchmark.
It is upstream's shipped deployment config for the whisper-streaming
'base' on CPU, Silero context registered, NO vad_detector, 5 s job
period, 30 s buffer, local_agree_dim 2) with only the diarization
settings added on top: the pyannote context and diarization_detector.
The crisper_whisper, lumen_granite and debug providers of the template
are omitted because they load models the benchmark never exercises.
The benchmark harness toggles diarization_detector (removes the
pyannote context and its worker) for its diarization-off runs, so the
off run is exactly upstream's shipped configuration: one worker.
Phase 2a: diarization is its own worker-pool job on its own worker
(worker 1), fed the same audio; captions on worker 0 never wait for it.
The diarization window, period, pyannote thread cap, nice and
segmentation step below are the Phase 2a defaults chosen by the window
